# OpenBar

A tiny macOS menu bar app that tracks AI coding-provider usage windows, credits, costs, and resets across 109 providers — Codex, OpenAI, Claude, Cursor, Gemini, Copilot, LiteLLM, Helmcode, v0, TypeSafe, and more.
